status: Operationalizes the frozen preregistration; not a changed threshold or new held-out protocol
unit: One complete visible response, its exact request, immutable Sources receipt, and frozen task clauses

axes.mechanics: Record driver/error/truncation status separately; a truncated answer fails completion even if an early sentence is correct.
axes.source_admission: Record source IDs, eligible source roles and scope, receipt binding, and whether the compared arms received the same originals. Source presence is not semantic success.
axes.factual_fidelity: Require all requested details to match supplied originals. Flag invented remembered facts and false claims of a complete search. For quotations, require original wording.
axes.author_intent: Preserve who proposed each option and whether the author accepted, rejected, deferred, or superseded it. Do not turn an assistant suggestion into author authority.
axes.open_state: Separate next actions and pending choices from deliberate ambiguity. Do not invent an obligation to resolve something the author explicitly left unresolved.
axes.current_task: Answer the actual recall question or perform the requested drafting. Current explicit author instructions override historical preferences. New prose is allowed when drafting, but invented prior decisions are not.
axes.citations: Any asserted source handle must bind to the supplied excerpt. Do not infer a citation requirement where the frozen task did not impose one.
axes.completion: Assess the entire response, including later contradictions, unsolicited reopening of discarded choices, repetition, and truncation. Never score only the best sentence.

screen: A candidate advances only if every frozen DEV case in both layouts completes without a semantic failure. Uncertain judgments block advancement pending resolution. No aggregate score can hide a privacy or authority failure.
interpretation: Even a perfect small DEV screen is not held-out acceptance, Qdrant retrieval accuracy, whole-manuscript coverage, or a production SLA.
